title: Incorrect reference to a link in Wiki
bug_description:
### 📚 The doc issue

In the wiki page [The Ultimate Guide to PyTorch Contributions](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/wiki/The-Ultimate-Guide-to-PyTorch-Contributions), under the section [Getting Started with Documentation changes](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/wiki/The-Ultimate-Guide-to-PyTorch-Contributions#getting-started-with-documentation-changes), it says:

> This generated HTML is copied to the docs folder in the main branch of [pytorch.github.io](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch.github.io/tree/master/docs), and is then served via GitHub pages.

Problem:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch.github.io/tree/master/docs does not exist.

### Suggest a potential alternative/fix

Correct it to:
  > This generated HTML is copied to the [docs](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/tree/main/docs) folder in the main branch of [pytorch](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch), and is then served via GitHub pages.

cc @svekars @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke
